title: Knives Out
overview: When renowned crime novelist Harlan Thrombey is found dead at his estate, inquisitive Detective Benoit Blanc is mysteriously enlisted to investigate. From Harlan's eccentric family to his devoted staff, Blanc sifts through a web of red herrings and self-serving lies to uncover the truth.
cast: ['Daniel Craig', 'Ana de Armas', 'Chris Evans', 'Jamie Lee Curtis']

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

title: Andhadhun
overview: A series of mysterious events changes the life of a blind pianist, who now must report a murder that he never witnessed—or did he?

title: 3 Idiots
overview: Two friends embark on a quest for a lost buddy. On this journey, they reminisce about their college days and remember the friend who inspired them to think independently, even as the rest of the world called them 'idiots'.

title: Tumbbad
overview: A mythological tale about a goddess who created the entire universe and her greed-stricken firstborn son, Hastar. Decades later, Vinayak seeks a cursed treasure in the ancestral village of Tumbbad.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
overview: Three friends decide to turn their fantasy vacation into reality after one of their number becomes engaged. Each friend picks an ultimate road trip dare in Spain, discovering confronting truths about their lives and relationships.

title: Inception
overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology, is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

title: Casablanca
overview: In Morocco during WWII, cynical American expatriate nightclub owner Rick Blaine is caught between love and virtue when his former lover and her heroic rebel husband enter his establishment seeking escape from the Nazis.

title: The Godfather
overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch Vito Corleone barely survives an assassination attempt, his youngest son Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a bloody mob war.

title: 12 Angry Men
overview: The defense and the prosecution have rested and the jury is filing into the jury room to decide if an eighteen-year-old boy is guilty or innocent of murdering his father. What begins as an open-and-shut case quickly becomes a miniature drama of each juror's prejudices and preconceptions.

title: Psycho
overview: When Phoenix secretary Marion Crane goes on the lam with $40,000 in cash, she stops for the night at the secluded Bates Motel, run by a quiet, polite young man named Norman with an eccentric mother upstairs.

title: Sholay
overview: After his family is murdered by a notorious bandit named Gabbar Singh, a retired police officer enlists two charismatic ex-convicts to help him capture the outlaw and bring justice to the dusty town of Ramgarh.

title: Coherence
overview: On the night of an astronomical anomaly, eight friends at a dinner party experience a troubling chain of reality-bending events. Paranoia sets in as alternate versions of themselves emerge from the dark neighborhood.

title: About Time
overview: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

title: The Menu
overview: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises disguised as haute cuisine.

title: Ship of Theseus
overview: Explores questions of identity, justice, beauty, meaning and death through an experimental photographer, an ailing monk and a stockbroker.

title: Get Out
overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
overview: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what's important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.
cast: ['Michelle Yeoh', 'Ke Huy Quan', 'Stephanie Hsu', 'Jamie Lee Curtis']

title: Whiplash
overview: Under the direction of a ruthless instructor, a talented young drummer begins to pursue perfection at any cost, pushing his physical and psychological limits to breaking point.

title: La La Land
overview: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair.

title: Parasite
overview: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

title: Stree
overview: In the small town of Chanderi, men live in fear of an evil spirit named 'Stree' who abducts men during festive nights. A ladies tailor named Vicky falls in love with an enigmatic woman and must uncover Stree's identity.

title: Interstellar
overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage to save humanity.

title: Gangs of Wasseypur
overview: A clash between Sultan and Shahid Khan leads to the expulsion of Khan from Wasseypur, igniting a deadly blood feud spanning three generations of coal mafia politics.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange world of spirits. After her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

title: Drishyam
overview: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law after they commit an unexpected crime to defend themselves against a predator.

title: Anand
overview: The story of a terminally ill man who wishes to live life to the fullest before the inevitable strikes, transforming the lives of everyone around him including his cynical oncologist doctor.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
overview: After reuniting with Gwen Stacy, Brooklyn's full-time friendly neighborhood Spider-Man is catapulted across the Multiverse, where he encounters the Spider Society, a team of Spider-People charged with protecting the Multiverse's very existence.
director: Joaquim Dos Santos, Kemp Powers, Justin K. Thompson

title: Queen
overview: A Delhi girl from a traditional family sets out on a solo honeymoon to Paris and Amsterdam after her fiance calls off their wedding just one day before the ceremony.

title: Past Lives
overview: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Decades later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.
